messages:
Sam (support): FYI customer Acme hit us with a big alert — p95/p99 for text-generation endpoints spiked after last runtime deploy. They're seeing 30-45% latency increases on longer prompts (>1k tokens). Can we triage? :grimacing:

Maya (eng-runtime): Ack. Which models/hosts? Any specific request IDs?

Sam (support): They pasted some request IDs — 7ef2c3... and 8b9a1f... — both on region us-west-2, model rdx-1.3b-quant, multi-turn generation. Reported after ~2026-03-14 22:10 UTC (after the deploy window).

Alex (eng-runtime): I noticed a related perf change in the runtime canary logs. We shipped a kernel switch that prefers FlashAttention2/SDPA for cross-attention by default for quantized models. Commit: 0a9f3c8. Might be the culprit.

Priya (eng-ml): FlashAttention2 has known regressions for certain KV cache layouts+q4_0 quantization on Ampere when seq_len distribution is skewed. If the heuristic misfires, it can choose a kernel that has worse throughput at high seq lengths.

Maya (eng-runtime): Can we reproduce locally? Sam, any chance Acme can share a minimal prompt and the request body? Even a synthetic repro that mimics their prompt length distribution is fine.

Sam (support): I've got a sanitized sample and an approximate prompt length histogram. Pasted below.

Sam (support): prompt_histogram: [100, 120, 200, 450, 1024, 1200, 1400]

Alex (eng-runtime): Trying a quick local load test now. Running the same model in our dev cluster with quantized weights. Command: ```bash
# repro load test (single client, variable seq lens)
python perf/loadtest.py --model rdx-1.3b-quant --concurrency 8 --sequence-hist "100,200,450,1024,1200" --batching off --duration 5m
```

Alex (eng-runtime): Seeing p95 ~170ms, p99 ~380ms. Baseline (pre-deploy) was p95 ~110ms, p99 ~220ms. GPU util and SM occupancy are weirdly low during spike windows — suggests kernel is slower per-op not just queuing.

Priya (eng-ml): Can you dump kernel selection logs? We have our runtime emit lines like `KERNEL_SELECT: cross_attention -> flash_attn_fwd_v2` or `KERNEL_SELECT: cross_attention -> sdpa_ref`.

Alex (eng-runtime): Pasted relevant snippet: ```
[12:23:41] KERNEL_SELECT: cross_attention seq_len=1200 batch=3 -> flash_attn_fwd_v2
[12:23:41] LAUNCH: flash_attn_fwd_v2 grid=(128,...) threads=1024
[12:23:41] STATUS: execution_time=38ms (expected ~18ms)
[12:23:41] fallback_check: no
```

Maya (eng-runtime): That matches the hypothesis. FlashAttn selected but slower. Short-term mitigation: force the runtime to prefer SDPA or the reference matmul for cross-attention for seq_len > 512 (or for q4_0). We have an env override for kernel preference: `REDWOOD_KERNEL_PREFERENCE`.

Priya (eng-ml): Try `REDWOOD_KERNEL_PREFERENCE=cross_attention:sdpa_ref,flash_attn_fwd_v2` or a specific var `REDWOOD_DISABLE_FLASHATTN=true` in the process env to force fallback.

Alex (eng-runtime): Quick test with env var set: p95 drops back to 115ms, p99 ~230ms. So this is an immediate mitigation.

Maya (eng-runtime): Good. Two-pronged plan: 1) Hotfix config rollout to affected clusters to set `REDWOOD_KERNEL_PREFERENCE`/disable FlashAttention for quantized rdx-1.3b until we have a proper fix. 2) Patch kernel-selection heuristic to consider seq_len and qtype (q4_0) and GPU SM occupancy history before preferring FA2. 3) Longer-term: re-run kernel microbenchmarks for q4_0 with current CUDA/cuBLAS+drivers and add tests to CI.

Jordan (oncall): I'll coordinate the hotfix. Can we spin a canary first? Apply env override in us-west-2 canary hosts (2 pods) and monitor p95/p99 + error rates for 30m.

Maya (eng-runtime): Assigned: Jordan - canary + metrics, Alex - rollout script and revert plan, Priya - regression test + microbench update, Maya - kernel-selection PR and unit tests. Sam, keep Acme in the loop and offer the mitigation (we can flip the kernel pref per-tenant for Dedicated customers).

Sam (support): I'll send the customer the short-term mitigation and ETA. They asked if this is going to be a config change on their side — reassure them we can handle it server-side but provide the env snippet if they want to try locally: ```bash
# temp workaround (server-side/proxy)
export REDWOOD_DISABLE_FLASHATTN=true
# or granular preference
export REDWOOD_KERNEL_PREFERENCE="cross_attention:sdpa_ref,flash_attn_fwd_v2"
```

Maya (eng-runtime): Note for the changelog: culprit commit 0a9f3c8 toggled default to FA2 for cross-attn. Reverting the default isn't ideal long-term; we'll make selection adaptive.

deploy-bot: deploy 2276 -> production/us-west-2 succeeded (user: Jordan) :white_check_mark:

Jordan (oncall): Canary looks good so far (10m): p95 down from 170ms->118ms, p99 from 380ms->235ms, no errors. Rolling to remaining us-west-2 hosts in 10m.

Maya (eng-runtime): After rollout, open PR with heuristic change and tests. Also add a perf regression alert that triggers when kernel-selection changes and p95 increases by >20% for 15m.

Alex (eng-runtime): I'll also add a small logging field in traces to record `kernel_hint` so Support can quickly correlate kernel choices with customer tickets.

Sam (support): Thanks all. I'll update ticket and schedule a follow-up post-mortem if needed. :thumbsup:

Maya (eng-runtime): Great work. Follow-ups: PRs and microbench artifacts linked in thread once available. :eyes:
